end.summary:
Ayaan practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.
They correctly counted sides in 2 of 3 attempts.
They linked three sides with three corners and counted four sides and corners in a rectangle.
They often identified shapes by upright position or equal-looking sides, including triangles.
The position-based triangle mix-up was still present at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting straight sides and corners, including checking a shape by tracing around it with a finger. Ayaan used the method successfully for some three- and four-sided shapes. They mixed up shape identity when a triangle was tilted or started at a different point, and this was not corrected by the last example. At home, draw triangles in several directions and have Ayaan trace the outline, count the sides and corners, and name the shape.
